phase: Phase 19 External Scientific Validation & Audited Registry

P19-EXP-01.hypothesis: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 representations transfer zero-shot to external defect SEM micrographs without retraining.
P19-EXP-01.independence: PREVIOUSLY_EVALUATED (Evaluated in Phase 2/14; unadapted in Phase 19)
P19-EXP-01.protocol: Nearest-neighbor class retrieval / class-consistency evaluation (leave-one-out query against 4590 gallery images)
P19-EXP-01.result: 4569 of 4591 queries correctly matched to their ground-truth defect class.

P19-EXP-02.hypothesis: Cross-domain representation shift across distinct microscopes and modalities is statistically significant.
P19-EXP-02.dataset: HCCI (In-Domain), Carinthia (Defect SEM), SEM Nanoscience, Bio-Image TEM
P19-EXP-02.protocol: Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD^2) and centroid cosine distance between in-domain and target embeddings
P19-EXP-02.result: All cross-domain distribution shifts are statistically significant (p = 0.0001); TEM cross-modality shift is greatest.

P19-EXP-03.hypothesis: Representation quality remains robust under moderate digital/optical perturbations but exhibits a breakdown threshold.
P19-EXP-03.protocol: Zero-shot class retrieval evaluated under Gaussian noise, defocus blur, and contrast perturbations
P19-EXP-03.result: High retention under noise and contrast (>96%), but heavy defocus blur (sigma >= 2.0) degrades retrieval to 69.83%.
P19-EXP-03.statistical_method: Empirical accuracy retention percentage calculation across 8 perturbation levels

P19-EXP-04.hypothesis: Perceptual hashing combined with cosine similarity screening identifies near-duplicate micrographs in external archives.
P19-EXP-04.protocol: Dual-stage filtering: 64-bit dHash Hamming distance <= 5 followed by cosine similarity >= 0.985
P19-EXP-04.result: Effective near-duplicate screening with 97.4% precision and 1.2% false positive rate.
P19-EXP-04.statistical_method: Standard binary classification evaluation against annotated pairs

P19-EXP-05.hypothesis: Unsupervised gradient energy metrics discriminate sharp from defocused micrographs on external instruments.
P19-EXP-05.protocol: Tenengrad / modified Laplacian variance computed over 2D grayscale intensity maps
P19-EXP-05.result: AUROC = 0.8640 (95% CI: [0.8420, 0.8850]), reliably separating sharp from defocused acquisitions.
P19-EXP-05.statistical_method: DeLong's method for non-parametric ROC curve standard error

P19-EXP-06.hypothesis: k-NN embedding density detects morphological novelty and cross-domain distribution shifts.
P19-EXP-06.protocol: Distance to k=5 nearest neighbors in in-domain reference memory bank
P19-EXP-06.result: AUROC = 0.8910; FPR at 95% TPR is 24.50%, indicating human triage is required for borderline cases.
P19-EXP-06.statistical_method: Non-parametric ROC curve analysis and operating point evaluation

P19-EXP-07.hypothesis: Minimum distance to in-domain reference set (D_ref) provides a discriminative signal for domain shift.
P19-EXP-07.dataset: HCCI vs Carinthia vs SEM Nanoscience
P19-EXP-07.protocol: L2 distance computation to closest in-domain reference exemplar
P19-EXP-07.result: External corpora show clear rightward distance shift (2.12x in-domain); probability calibration not claimed.
P19-EXP-07.statistical_method: Two-sample t-test for difference in means (t=38.4, p < 1e-12)

P19-EXP-08.hypothesis: Automated curation triage prioritization aligns with double-blinded expert review decisions.
P19-EXP-08.independence: Independent expert annotators; zero label leakage to training
P19-EXP-08.protocol: Double-blinded review of 120 stratified cases by 2 independent domain experts
P19-EXP-08.result: Substantial agreement (kappa = 0.8420); 110 of 120 cases confirmed as actionable curation items.

P19-EXP-09.hypothesis: The automated ingestion pipeline ingests held-out external micrographs with full provenance logging.
P19-EXP-09.independence: Held-out batch from external SEM pool
P19-EXP-09.protocol: Automated pipeline ingestion: feature extraction, metadata validation, focus scoring, index insertion
P19-EXP-09.result: 100/100 images ingested with zero errors (14.80 img/s); 100 SHA-256 provenance records logged.
P19-EXP-09.statistical_method: Deterministic execution count and cryptographic hash verification

P19-EXP-10.hypothesis: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 representations yield higher nearest-neighbor class consistency than CLIP and ResNet-50.
P19-EXP-10.protocol: Comparative evaluation of DINOv2 vs CLIP ViT-B/32 and ImageNet ResNet-50
P19-EXP-10.model: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 vs CLIP ViT-B/32 vs ResNet-50
P19-EXP-10.result: DINOv2 achieved higher Micro R@1 (0.9952) than CLIP (0.7840) and ResNet-50 (0.6420) on SEM defect data.
P19-EXP-10.statistical_method: Descriptive point estimates; inferential p-value demoted due to absence of persisted paired query arrays
